verdict: Ads are running but producing zero leads — the funnel is not yet complete.
narrative: In the last 28 days, $171.14 in Meta ad spend generated 342 clicks and zero leads, because the landing pages and conversion tracking needed to capture those visitors are not yet live. This is a funnel gap, not an ad performance problem — the traffic is arriving but has nowhere to go. Nine setup milestones that were due by July and August 31 remain undelivered, and closing those is the immediate priority. Landing pages, conversion tracking, and lead capture are being completed now. Once those are live, the existing click volume gives a real baseline to optimize from.
